answer_1.quote: We evaluate the instruction following capability of the models using three publicly available benchmarks... We fine-tune the OpenLLaMA model on all instruction following datasets... The datasets include Chain of Thoughts (CoT), Math QA, P3, InstDial, and SNI, covering tasks such as reasoning, dialogue and coding.
answer_1.outputs: Generated instruction-following text responses (answers, dialogues, code snippets, reasoning steps)

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the instruction following capability of the models using three publicly available benchmarks, namely InstructEval, LM-evaluation-harness and HELM. We perform 5-shot evaluation on MMLU and HELM, and 3-shot evaluation on BBH and DROP.
